translations.web: “For there is a trial. What if even the rod that condemns will be no more?” says the Lord Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Surely testing will come! And what if even the scepter, which the sword despises, does not continue?’ declares the Lord GOD.
translations.kjv: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: For there is a trial; and what if even the rod that contemneth shall be no more? saith the Lord Jehovah.
